How the Pipedrive MCP server works

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely connect to external tools and data sources. With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.

Step 1: Connect securely

Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login. No coding, APIs, middleware or developer support required.

Step 2: Ask your AI to act

Simply tell ChatGPT or Claude what you want to do, using plain language directly from its input box.

Step 3: Get instant results

Your AI assistant can find information, update records, create activities and automate workflows using live Pipedrive data.

Bring Pipedrive into your AI assistant

Sales work is increasingly happening inside AI assistants. Pipedrive MCP brings your CRM into that workflow, giving your AI assistant secure access to your live CRM data so it can help you move deals forward, automate busywork and surface insights instantly.

Query your CRM

Search deals, contacts, organizations and leads. Retrieve pipeline details, analyze sales activity and access customer information in seconds.

Take action

Create and update deals, contacts and activities. Convert leads, schedule follow-ups and keep your CRM up to date without manual data entry.

Automate workflows

Turn meeting notes into CRM records, generate follow-up tasks and automate repetitive sales workflows through natural conversation.

Your AI assistant gets access. You stay in control.

An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.

Frequently asked questions
What is the Pipedrive MCP server?

Pipedrive MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects your AI assistant directly to Pipedrive, allowing it to securely access, update and act on your CRM data using natural language.

What can I do with it?

You can query CRM data, update records and automate workflows directly from your AI assistant. Find deals, update contacts, create activities, analyze pipelines and automate repetitive tasks using natural “plain” language.

Who can use the Pipedrive MCP?

All Pipedrive customers, on every plan. Usage is subject to token limits based on your plan and you can purchase additional tokens if needed.

How do I get started with the Pipedrive MCP server?

Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes through secure OAuth, no coding or developer required. See the Pipedrive MCP documentation for step-by-step instructions.

Which AI assistants are supported?

Pipedrive MCP works with any AI assistant that supports custom MCP connections. We provide setup guides for ChatGPT and Claude and other assistants can connect using the Pipedrive MCP server URL.

Does it adhere to my existing Pipedrive permissions?

Yes. Your AI assistant can only access and modify data your Pipedrive user already has permission to view and edit. All actions are recorded in the change log for full auditability.

Is my data safe?

Yes. Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive and follows our security standards. Your AI assistant can only access data within the scope of your permissions. Your AI provider's own privacy and security policies also apply.

Is there an extra cost?

Pipedrive MCP is available on all Pipedrive plans. Usage is based on token limits included in your plan and additional tokens can be purchased if needed.
